By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to to ship AI products. THE ROLE We're looking for a Solutions Product Marketing Manager to define and own Baseten's up-market, enterprise, and industries go-to-market strategy. You'll build the playbook that helps Baseten win large, complex deals and the vertical go-to-market strategies that let us compete in Financial Services, and Health & Life Sciences, and the use cases that scale across all of them. This is a highly cross-functional, largely greenfield role. You'll partner closely with the Industries sales team, product marketing, demand gen, and executive leadership to build on our enterprise go to market motion. RESPONSIBILITIES Enterprise Deal Playbook & Buyer Enablement - Build the enterprise deal playbook and full bill of materials (BOM) — pricing guides, one-pagers, TCO/ROI guides, landing pages, and event/field collateral — mapped to every stage of the buyer's journey - Build the system for keeping every sales asset current — clear ownership, last-updated dates, and a refresh cadence - Develop industry-specific event concepts featuring anchor customers and AI-native accounts to build credibility with target executive audiences Vertical GTM & Industry Go-to-Market Kits - Design and help launch an ABM experiments in partnership with demand gen Industries AE Enablement & Onboarding - Design role-specific onboarding for Industries AEs, including certifications, customer-grounded scenarios, and async, refreshable content - Build sales playbooks tied to real customer examples, and package assets into an AE-ready enablement motion (first call, competitive deals, legal/finance/procurement, TCO/ROI, self-hosted) - Become a trusted partner to the industries team so onboarding and enablement stay grounded in what sellers actually need REQUIREMENTS - 6+ years in product marketing, solutions marketing, or a related GTM function, ideally at a technical or infrastructure company - Experience building enterprise or vertical go-to-market motions — ICP definition, buyer journey mapping, and full-funnel sales collateral - Comfort translating technical, infrastructure-heavy concepts (inference, self-hosted deployment, TCO/ROI) into narratives for both technical buyers and non-technical stakeholders like legal, finance, and procurement - Track record designing and running sales enablement or onboarding programs for technical sellers - Strong cross-functional coordination skills — you can pull together sales, customer marketing, demand gen, and executives around a shared plan - Experience in (or a fast ability to ramp on) financial services, manufacturing/industrial, or health/life sciences - Experience running or contributing to a Customer Advisory Board or executive champion program - Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure, inference, or developer tools - Experience partnering with technology partners on co-marketing or joint events BENEFITS - Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity. - flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.title: (Senior) Scientist, Agentic Systems for Pipeline Strategy
flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.description: About Pioneering Intelligence Pioneering Intelligence builds on Flagship Pioneering’s legacy of founding cutting-edge science and computational ventures, harnessing recent advances in AI, machine learning, and data to accelerate fundamental research and create a portfolio of AI-first companies. As part of Flagship’s integrated model of science, entrepreneurship, and capital, it transforms breakthrough ideas into world-changing companies, elevating the AI advances happening across the ecosystem in human health, sustainability, and beyond. Position Summary We are seeking a (Senior) Scientist to join Pioneering Intelligence (PI), a Flagship initiative dedicated to developing AI/ML-powered platforms for transformative applications in life sciences. This role will serve as PI's in-house expert in clinical and commercial strategy, and will lead the codification of therapeutic pipeline strategy as agentic capabilities: translating the judgment that today lives in the heads of senior strategic and translational leaders into autonomous systems that identify, evaluate, and prioritize opportunities to create new medicines at a level of scale and rigor that humans alone cannot achieve. This is a senior, hands-on role for a therapeutic strategy or business development leader who has been seriously engaged with AI, using LLMs and agentic tools in their own work and building intuition for what these systems can and cannot do, and wants their next chapter to be one where AI is at the center, not the side. The successful candidate brings deep clinical and commercial pipeline strategy expertise and a real working relationship with frontier AI; PI brings the engineering depth and research environment to take that AI work to the next level. Although the role sits within PI, the (Senior) Scientist will collaborate extensively with business and strategy analysts across the Flagship ecosystem, ensuring that agentic capabilities are grounded in the real strategic questions driving decisions across the enterprise. Their work will ultimatly impact the whole Flagship ecosystem. Responsibilities Serve as PI's in-house subject matter expert on clinical and commercial pipeline strategy, embedding domain judgment directly into the AI capabilities PI develops. Codify pipeline strategy into agentic systems: taking the implicit frameworks used by senior strategists (how unmet need is assessed, how patient populations are sized and stratified, how clinical and commercial landscapes are weighed) and turning them into agentic workflows that execute autonomously. Own the "legitimate patient need" problem end-to-end: define what it means for an agentic tool to identify and value a real, underserved patient need, what a product that addresses it looks like, and build the evaluations, ground-truth sets, and feedback loops that make agent outputs trustworthy enough to inform pipeline decisions. Prototype agentic capabilities directly: building prompts, tools, and orchestration logic, and partnering with engineering to harden systems for production use. Help set the technical and strategic direction for how agentic capabilities are developed and deployed across pipeline strategy at Flagship and its ecosystem companies. Collaborate closely with business and strategy analysts across the ecosystem translating their strategic questions into agent specifications and translating emerging agent capabilities back into strategic possibilities. Present progress and findings in research and product development forums. Qualifications PhD or MD (or equivalent doctoral-level training) in a life science, medical, or related discipline. Deep domain expertise in clinical and commercial pipeline strategy, drug development, or therapeutic area strategy, with a track record of personally making or directly influencing portfolio and indication-selection decisions. getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:2c1e0a08-093.title: HR Operations Specialist
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:2c1e0a08-093.description: About Wing AI Wing AI is a technology-enabled talent platform helping businesses scale with high-quality global talent and AI-powered support. We manage the full talent lifecycle from sourcing and onboarding to training and performance so companies can focus on what matters most. Trusted by thousands of teams worldwide, Wing AI combines human expertise with smart systems to deliver fast, reliable, and scalable execution for modern businesses. Role Overview The HR Operations Specialist (Onboarding & Engagement) is responsible for delivering a seamless and engaging employee experience from pre-employment through onboarding and throughout the employee lifecycle. This role oversees onboarding administration, orientation programs, employee engagement initiatives, recognition programs, surveys, and culture-building activities while ensuring compliance with company policies and HR processes. The specialist works closely with hiring managers, department leaders, and cross-functional teams to foster a positive employee experience and strengthen organizational culture.
responsibilities: 1. New Hire Onboarding
Manage the end-to-end onboarding process for all new hires.
Coordinate pre-employment requirements, onboarding schedules, and documentation.
Conduct or facilitate new hire orientation sessions.
Ensure timely completion of onboarding tasks, system access, equipment coordination, and HRIS enrollment.
Monitor completion of mandatory onboarding courses, handbook acknowledgment, company policies, and compliance requirements.
Serve as the primary HR contact for new hires during their onboarding period.
Continuously improve the onboarding experience based on survey results and feedback.
2. Employee Engagement
Plan, organize, and execute employee engagement programs, celebrations, wellness activities, and company events.
Develop initiatives that promote company culture, collaboration, and employee morale.
Coordinate recognition and appreciation programs including service awards, employee appreciation activities, and incentive programs.
Partner with department leaders to implement engagement strategies across teams.
Monitor participation and recommend improvements to increase employee involvement.
3. Employee Surveys & Feedback
Administer onboarding surveys, engagement surveys, pulse surveys, and employee satisfaction surveys.
Analyze survey results and identify trends, concerns, and opportunities for improvement.
Prepare reports and recommendations for HR leadership.
Track action plans resulting from survey feedback.
4. Employee Experience
Support initiatives that improve the overall employee journey from onboarding to offboarding.
Coordinate welcome kits, onboarding materials, and employee communications.
Assist in implementing culture-building initiatives aligned with company values.
Promote HR programs, policies, and benefits through effective communication.
5. HR Administration
Maintain accurate onboarding records within the HRIS.
Ensure all employee documents are complete and properly filed.
Monitor completion of required HR documentation and compliance requirements.
Coordinate with other departments regarding new hire requirements.
Assist in updating HR forms, onboarding guides, and employee resources.
6. Internal Communications
Prepare HR announcements related to engagement activities, onboarding, holidays, and employee programs.
Develop newsletters, employee communications, and HR campaigns.
Maintain onboarding content within the Learning Management System (LMS) or HRIS.
Promote participation in HR initiatives through various communication channels.
7. Continuous Improvement
Recommend improvements to onboarding processes and employee engagement programs.
Benchmark HR best practices and introduce innovative employee experience initiatives.
Assist in HR projects related to culture, employer branding, and employee retention.
qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, or a related field.
At least 2 years of experience in HR Operations, Employee Engagement, Onboarding, or Employee Experience.
Experience coordinating employee events, orientations, or engagement programs.
Experience using HRIS and Learning Management Systems is preferred.
Strong organizational and project coordination skills.
Knowledge of HR best practices and employee engagement strategies.
Familiarity with Philippine labor laws and HR compliance requirements.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, HRIS, and survey platforms.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:f488f7bd-2ad8-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Project Manager in Marketing Technologies (m/w/d) based in Italy. This is a senior-level opportunity to lead complex digital and Marketing Technology projects from initial planning through implementation, launch, and optimization. You’ll act as the central link between customers, technical specialists, and business stakeholders, turning ambitious goals into structured delivery plans. The role combines strategic project leadership with enough technical depth to navigate AI, data, digital platforms, integrations, and implementation constraints. You’ll coordinate multidisciplinary teams spanning Engineering, AI, Data, UX, Analytics, and Marketing to deliver measurable business outcomes. Strong ownership, proactive risk management, budget control, and clear stakeholder communication will be central to your success. You’ll operate in a dynamic, fast-moving environment where ambiguity is common and the ability to create structure and momentum is highly valued. It’s an ideal role for an experienced project leader who enjoys customer-facing work, complex technology, and driving impactful digital transformation. Take end-to-end ownership of complex Marketing Technology and digital projects, from solution definition and planning through implementation, launch, and continuous optimization. Translate customer needs and business objectives into clearly defined project scopes, delivery plans, milestones, work packages, and actionable tasks in collaboration with technical leads. Build and manage project roadmaps, backlogs, priorities, dependencies, and delivery timelines in close alignment with customers and internal teams. Coordinate multidisciplinary teams across software development, AI, data, UX, analytics, and marketing to ensure effective collaboration and high-quality delivery. Proactively manage schedules, resources, dependencies, risks, issues, and blockers to maintain transparent and predictable project execution. Drive project-level decisions throughout the delivery lifecycle, balancing customer expectations, technical feasibility, resources, timelines, budgets, and business objectives. Own project budget planning, monitoring, and financial transparency while continuously aligning scope, effort, and project progress. Engage in technical discussions with sufficient depth to understand architecture considerations, implementation constraints, data dependencies, integration requirements, and delivery risks. Translate complex technical concepts into clear, structured, and business-relevant communication for customers, business stakeholders, and internal teams. Build strong, trusted relationships with customers through proactive communication, transparent project management, and consistent alignment. Prepare and facilitate customer meetings, project updates, workshops, steering committees, and decision-making sessions. Identify risks, blockers, scope changes, and opportunities for improvement early, and proactively recommend practical solutions. Advise customers on priorities and informed decision-making while clearly communicating the implications of scope, budget, timelines, and technical complexity. Requirements: At least 7 years of proven experience as a Project Manager, with substantial ownership of digital products across roadmap execution, delivery, and continuous development. Demonstrated experience delivering AI-enabled, data-driven, or otherwise technically complex digital products or IT solutions.
